claim: A 2026 primary preprint reports full-wave simulated wide-angle 3D steering from a 250 GHz hemispherical graphene/gold transmitarray with 121 tunable sectors and simulated antenna efficiency of roughly 71-80 percent across investigated directions.

provenance.source_title: Active Hemispherical Metasurface Transmitarray Antenna for Wide-Angle 3D Beam Steering and Target Tracking
provenance.demonstrated_scale: 250 GHz hemispherical transmitarray with 121 independently tunable sectors
limitations: Numerical simulation rather than a reported physical or flight demonstration.
The antenna geometry, frequency, control implementation, mass, and power scale are not SNS-specific.
Antenna efficiency is not end-to-end energy-transfer efficiency.
provenance.fact_summary: The paper reports -78 to +78 degree elevation steering, full 360 degree azimuthal coverage, 11.38-14.72 dBi directivity, and simulated antenna efficiency from 71 to 80 percent across investigated steering directions.
provenance.inference_summary: Wide-angle programmable steering is sufficiently concrete to justify explicit angle/error/efficiency terms in QST-META-0001's abstraction.
provenance.speculation_summary: Whether a future SNS-scale surface can preserve useful steering while satisfying mass, power, thermal, fabrication, and space-environment constraints remains unknown.
